page_title: BHA 1-1 SHU | Brighton v Sheffield Utd 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' John Brooks is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is being substituted because of an injury. Paul Heckingbottom sends William Osula on the pitch.
90+5' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+3' The resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+3' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Pascal Gross (Brighton), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) makes a strong challenge and John Brooks blows for a foul. Brighton win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
85' Paul Heckingbottom is forced to make a change. James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Anis Slimane.
84' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
80' Joao Pedro (Brighton) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
78' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
77' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Carlos Baleba (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
75' Roberto De Zerbi is stunned as referee John Brooks shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
74' 1 - 1 This is definitely not what Adam Webster (Brighton) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:1.
73' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
71' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Ansu Fati will be replaced by Joel Veltman (Brighton).
71' Substitution. Billy Gilmour did his best and is replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).
69' Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
66' Simon Adingra (Brighton) gets booked for the first time in this match.
65' This should have been a goal! Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) sends a killer pass into the box, but James McAtee can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.
62' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton) causes Wesley Foderingham little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
62' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pascal Gross (Brighton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

62' Wesley Foderingham pulls off a great save to deny Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. Brighton get a corner.
59' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
59' Pascal Gross (Brighton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
58' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Joao Pedro, who fails to shoot. Brighton win a corner.
54' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
54' Referee John Brooks signals NO PENALTY for Brighton after a VAR review!

53' Play continues despite the shouts by some Brighton players for a penalty. Wait! Referee John Brooks interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
53' Surely that's handball by one of the Sheffield Utd players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
53' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
52' Paul Heckingbottom is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Vini Souza suffers an injury and Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
51' That was close by Joao Pedro (Brighton)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
49' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' The game is over for Adam Lallana. Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Facundo Buonanotte is replaced by Joao Pedro (Brighton).
46' Referee John Brooks blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' The corner is swung in but Sheffield Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+5' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd win a corner kick.
45+3' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) receives a yellow card for infringement.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
45+3' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed under the crossbar, but Wesley Foderingham was alert and made an astonishing save!

45+3' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
45+2' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

43' Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul.
41' So close! Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
40' A quickly taken corner by Sheffield Utd.
36' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
34' Adam Webster (Brighton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and John Brooks blows for a foul.
33' The linesman signals that Ansu Fati (Brighton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
30' The ball falls kindly for Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post.
30' Brighton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' Pascal Gross (Brighton) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner.
29' John Brooks has a clear sight and sees a foul from James McAtee (Sheffield Utd).
25' The referee blows his whistle as Simon Adingra (Brighton) was too aggressive in his challenge.
25' The ball is cleared after Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Brighton keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
18' Simon Adingra (Brighton) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
15' Ansu Fati (Brighton) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Wesley Foderingham is alert and denies him.
13' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
11' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) jumps into a tackle and John Brooks signals a foul.
10' Adam Lallana (Brighton) was too forceful with his tackle and John Brooks interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
7' The game is interrupted now, Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
6' 1 - 0 Simon Adingra (Brighton) receives an accurate low pass inside the box and scores! His shot goes to the bottom left corner, ricocheting in off the post.
4' Ansu Fati (Brighton) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham makes a comfortable save.
3' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
1' The first half has started.
Sheffield Utd will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's John Brooks.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
